verses: Then I saw the soul of a woman who ever scraped her own body and face with an iron comb, and ever dug an iron hill with her breasts.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this woman?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who, in the world, committed a crime, and through a desire for wealth, gave no milk to her own infant. And now she ever makes an outcry thus: "Here let me dig into this hill, that I may give milk to that infant." Yet until the reestablishment of the world Frashegird, she does not reach the infant.'
